# vverify.social.tsv line carried the verdict word `done`, which is not one of
# match | partial | deferred | not-wired, so apply-verify skipped it and an
# older `partial` kept scoring. That is still true of three more rows at HEAD -
# (5171-270124) all read `done`. This pass writes `match` where it measures a

So the cluster LEADS the lines on this board too, and the side is not a standing question at all - it is three screen boards against one component board, and the component board governs its own row, not this one. HEAD already drew it left (QUOTE_CLUSTER then the text column, QUOTE_BAR `rounded-l-[6px]`), so the item closes with no change to the order. THE DEPARTURE, MEASURED AND BUILT IN 135c3918c: the 768 rung of the cluster is the board's OWN and not the phone's. The file carried a comment saying "768 was not drawn on any board this lane opened, so it carries the phone rung rather than an interpolation", and the phone rung is a 30 avatar in a 38 cluster; this board draws a 34 avatar in a 42 cluster, 4 + 4 + 34 == 42 against the phone's 4 + 4 + 30 == 38 and the desktop's 4 + 6 + 38 == 48.
